text_block_list.text:
Reviewing race footage of Mejiro McQueen 
before training has become a daily routine 
for Tokai Teio.

Yet, she still couldn't understand why she 
fell short of her.

What she lacked... was the strong will to 
crawl back up from rock bottom. Realizing 
this, the Trainer decided to tell her.

Tokai Teio rejected it at first. However, 
realizing running away wouldn't make her 
stronger, she decided to face it head-on.

Tokai Teio accepted her defeat to Mejiro 
McQueen, using that frustration as a 
springboard to achieve further growth.
